## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman characterized by a sharp, angular figure without curves. Her dark hair, which is streaked with gray that has grown grayer over time, is typically twisted behind her head in a hard little knot, while her face features sallow cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla Cuthbert is a sensible, self-contained, and determined woman who is known for her skill in making three-year-old homemade currant wine. In raising [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), she views her conscientious upbringing of the child as an exclusive duty, often seeking to drill her into a tranquil uniformity of disposition and believing every remark to a child should have a moral attached. Though naturally strict, critical, and mellow over time, Marilla harbors a deep affection and pride for the girl. However, due to her nature and habit, she remains undemonstrative and reluctant to outwardly express these feelings.

## History

In her youth, Marilla Cuthbert suffered a painful childhood remark about her looks and later held a sulky grudge against John Blythe after a quarrel, refusing to forgive him. Living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), she decides to adopt an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), but is shocked when an orphan girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), arrives instead. Although Marilla initially insists on sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back, she pities Anne's hard childhood, dislikes a harsh alternative guardian, and resolves to keep and properly educate her. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets into a fiery conflict with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) over her looks, Marilla orders her to apologize, but feels a warm surge of affection for the girl after the apology is made. When her mother's inherited amethyst brooch goes missing, Marilla unjustly confines [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a false confession until she discovers the brooch snagged on her own shawl and sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a Sunday-school picnic. Marilla continues to guide [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through various mishaps, such as accidentally serving currant wine to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) or dyeing her hair green, which forces Marilla to cut it off completely. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks her ankle after a dare, Marilla realizes how deeply she cares for her. Marilla and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) support [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joining an advanced class for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excels and wins the Avery scholarship. Tragedy strikes when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly dies after a bank failure, leaving Marilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to grieve together. Facing severe eyesight loss that threatens to force the sale of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Marilla confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance with John Blythe, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ultimately gives up her college scholarship to stay home, teach locally, and save the farm.

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla acts as Anne's guardian, mentor, and good friend after taking her into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though initially shocked when an orphan girl arrived instead of the expected boy, Marilla decided to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rather than let her be placed with the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md). She takes charge of Anne's upbringing, teaching her practical skills, neatness, and religious instruction, while growing increasingly fond of the girl despite Anne's theatrical nature and temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +25 more_

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Marilla lives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). While Marilla initially insists on returning [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the adoption mix-up, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly advocates for keeping her, leading Marilla to consult him before making the final decision. Although Marilla handles Anne's strict upbringing and discipline, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) frequently tempers her severity by offering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quiet support, gifts, and encouragement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), +42 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a neighbor and friend to Marilla who frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to share her opinion on local matters. Though [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) strongly disapproves of the decision to adopt an orphan and causes friction by offending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Marilla values her counsel, even following Rachel's advice to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) study at home when the girl refuses to attend school.
